image_description: A close-up view of a car wheel mounted on a silver vehicle. The wheel features a five-spoke alloy rim with a two-tone finish (black and machined silver). A black rubber tire is mounted on the rim, showing visible tread patterns and sidewall details. The central hub displays a logo and lug nuts. The wheel is situated within the wheel well of the car, with part of the fender and side skirt visible.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of wheel (alloy vs steel) and verify class alignment with high confidence.
To check for edge bleeding between the complex spoke geometry and the background/tire, ensuring no fusion artifacts.
To verify the depth relationship between the tire, rim face, and center hub, ensuring the recessed hub looks physically correct.
To inspect the tire sidewall and tread for any smearing, melting, or unnatural texture repetition common in AI generation.

focus_areas: Spoke symmetry and connection points to the hub
Reflection consistency on the metallic surfaces
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the reflections on the alloy spokes; AI often fails to maintain consistent light source directionality on complex curved metallic surfaces. Also, verify that the lug nuts are not 'melting' into the center cap, a common artifact in wheel generation.
